disputedCells.currentTarget: La principal navegación
disputedCells.candidateTarget: Navegación principal
disputedCells.rationale: The current word order “La principal navegación” is understandable but unidiomatic for this concise navigation label. “Navegación principal” is the natural label form and preserves the aria-label meaning.

disputedCells.currentTarget: confirmado manualmente por el propietario de la biblioteca.
disputedCells.candidateTarget: Confirmado manualmente por el propietario de la biblioteca.
disputedCells.rationale: The source is a complete sentence, but the current target starts lowercase. Capitalizing the sentence improves correctness without changing the meaning.

disputedCells.currentTarget: Manual confirmado pelo proprietário da biblioteca.
disputedCells.candidateTarget: Confirmado manualmente pelo proprietário da biblioteca.
disputedCells.rationale: “Manual confirmado” reads as a manual/handbook that was confirmed. The source means the mapping was confirmed manually; “manualmente” restores that adverbial meaning.

disputedCells.currentTarget: تأكيد يدويا من قبل صاحب المكتبة.
disputedCells.candidateTarget: تم التأكيد يدويًا من قِبل مالك المكتبة.
disputedCells.rationale: The current nominal phrase means roughly “manual confirmation by the library owner” and is awkward for the complete status sentence. The proposed passive sentence states that it was manually confirmed. Arabic fluency confidence is limited.

disputedCells.currentTarget: Được xác nhận bằng tay bởi chủ sở hữu thư viện.
disputedCells.candidateTarget: Được chủ sở hữu thư viện xác nhận thủ công.
disputedCells.rationale: “Bằng tay” literally means “by hand.” “Thủ công” is the clearer conventional term for manual confirmation in this software status. Vietnamese idiom confidence is limited.

disputedCells.currentTarget: Ditegaskan secara manual oleh pemilik perpustakaan.
disputedCells.candidateTarget: Dikonfirmasi secara manual oleh pemilik perpustakaan.
disputedCells.rationale: “Ditegaskan” means asserted/emphasized, not confirmed. “Dikonfirmasi” matches the source action of confirming the manual mapping.

disputedCells.currentTarget: Manual dikonfirmasi
disputedCells.candidateTarget: Dikonfirmasi secara manual
disputedCells.rationale: “Manual dikonfirmasi” is awkward and can read as a manual being confirmed. “Dikonfirmasi secara manual” expresses the passive status “manually confirmed.”

disputedCells.currentTarget: Sugestão de título do fornecedor de metadados; confirmação antes de renomear
disputedCells.candidateTarget: Sugestão de título do fornecedor de metadados; confirme antes de renomear
disputedCells.rationale: The current second clause is a noun phrase (“confirmation before renaming”), while the source directly instructs the user to confirm. The imperative keeps the caller’s action clear.

disputedCells.currentTarget: Saran judul dari penyedia metadata; konfirmasi sebelum mengganti nama
disputedCells.candidateTarget: Saran judul dari penyedia metadata; konfirmasikan sebelum mengganti nama
disputedCells.rationale: The current second clause says “confirmation before renaming” rather than directly asking the user to confirm. The suggested imperative better matches this review-before-rename status.

disputedCells.currentTarget: Rota de metadados não configurada
disputedCells.candidateTarget: Raiz de metadados não configurada
disputedCells.rationale: “Rota” means route/path, but this source is specifically the metadata root directory. “Raiz” restores the configured-root meaning.

disputedCells.currentTarget: Metadata root không được cấu hình
disputedCells.candidateTarget: Thư mục gốc siêu dữ liệu chưa được cấu hình
disputedCells.rationale: The current target leaves “Metadata root” in English. The suggested Vietnamese phrase translates the root directory and the not-configured state.

disputedCells.currentTarget: Metadata root tidak terkonfigurasi
disputedCells.candidateTarget: Direktori utama metadata belum dikonfigurasi
disputedCells.rationale: The current target leaves “Metadata root” untranslated. The suggested wording names the main/root metadata directory and states that it has not been configured.

disputedCells.currentTarget: 最低种子
disputedCells.candidateTarget: 最少做种者数
disputedCells.rationale: The caller is a minimum count of seeder peers. “最低种子” can be read as minimum seeds rather than the number of seeding peers; “做种者数” makes the counted entity explicit. Chinese torrent terminology confidence is limited.

disputedCells.currentTarget: 最低種子
disputedCells.candidateTarget: 最小シーダー数
disputedCells.rationale: The field is a numeric minimum for torrent seeders. “最低種子” reads as minimum seeds and omits the count unit; “シーダー数” names the peer count.

disputedCells.currentTarget: 最低種子
disputedCells.candidateTarget: 最少做種者數
disputedCells.rationale: The caller is a minimum count of seeder peers. “最低種子” can be read as minimum seeds rather than the number of seeding peers; “做種者數” makes the counted entity explicit. Traditional Chinese torrent terminology confidence is limited.

disputedCells.currentTarget: {name} 发送不 JSON 的东西
disputedCells.candidateTarget: {name} 发送了非 JSON 格式的内容
disputedCells.rationale: “发送不 JSON 的东西” is ungrammatical and obscures the format distinction. The proposed sentence clearly says the peer sent content that was not in JSON format.

disputedCells.currentTarget: {name} कुछ भेजा जो JSON नहीं था
disputedCells.candidateTarget: {name} ने कुछ ऐसा भेजा जो JSON नहीं था
disputedCells.rationale: The current sentence omits the ergative marker “ने” after the sender’s name, making the subject/action relation ungrammatical. The proposed form is grammatical and preserves the source meaning.

disputedCells.currentTarget: {name} envoie quelque chose qui n'était pas JSON
disputedCells.candidateTarget: {name} a envoyé quelque chose qui n’était pas au format JSON
disputedCells.rationale: The current “envoie” is present tense, while the source reports a completed send. “A envoyé” restores the past event; “au format JSON” makes the format meaning explicit.

disputedCells.currentTarget: {name} أرسلت شيئا لم يكن JSON
disputedCells.candidateTarget: المحتوى الذي أرسله {name} ليس بصيغة JSON
disputedCells.rationale: The current verb “أرسلت” marks the sender as feminine, but {name} can be any peer name. Recasting the sentence around “the content sent by {name}” avoids imposing the sender’s gender. Arabic phrasing confidence is limited.

disputedCells.currentTarget: {name}는 JSON가 아닌 것을 보냈습니다.
disputedCells.candidateTarget: {name}이(가) JSON이 아닌 내용을 보냈습니다.
disputedCells.rationale: The current particle “가” does not agree with the final sound of the Latin token JSON. “이(가)” accommodates either final-sound class and “내용” reads naturally for a response body.

disputedCells.currentTarget: {name} 發送不 JSON 的東西
disputedCells.candidateTarget: {name} 傳送了非 JSON 格式的內容
disputedCells.rationale: “發送不 JSON 的東西” is ungrammatical and obscures the format distinction. The proposed sentence clearly says the peer sent content that was not in JSON format.
